# Moksh AI

> Moksh AI (Moksh Infotech Pvt Ltd, part of Moksh Group) designs, builds and runs AI agents and automation for managed service providers (MSPs) and operations-heavy businesses. Agents work inside existing tools (PSA/ITSM, RMM, Microsoft 365, business systems), handle repetitive work such as ticket triage, alert correlation and document preparation, and route anything that needs judgement or carries security risk to a person. US office: Lake Hiawatha, New Jersey. Delivery team: Ahmedabad, India. Contact: info@mokshtech.net.

## Services
- [AI strategy & consulting](https://mokshai.net/services/ai-consulting/): workflow mapping, ranked automation candidates, business case and pilot brief
- [Custom AI agents & development](https://mokshai.net/services/custom-ai-development/): agents on your PSA, RMM, Microsoft 365 and business systems
- [Implementation & training](https://mokshai.net/services/ai-implementation-training/): staged rollout and role-based training
- [AI cost optimisation](https://mokshai.net/services/ai-cost-optimization/): remove unused and overlapping AI subscriptions

## Who it is for
- [AI agents for MSPs](https://mokshai.net/msp/): ticket triage, tier-1 resolution, NOC alert correlation, documentation, white-label AI
- [AI automation for operations teams](https://mokshai.net/operations/): quote preparation, document intake, status updates, reporting
